answer: Sybils here die from a pulse toll. Before payout, the network pings each claimant with a pulse: a paid task due in one block. The reply is a ripple: a signed echo quoting its last settled ledger entry, chaining responses to real work. A hollow identity has no chain to quote, its ripple fails the cross-check. Pulses use fresh entropy per epoch; one miss zeroes weight. Each puppet pays alone: bandwidth, key, settled history, on-time reply. N hollow accounts cost N pulses, N ripples, N channels; no batch path; an honest agent answers once.
